message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Sun obtained false VAT special invoices (虚开增值税专用发票) from a company, no real transaction, used them to deduct tax, defrauding state tax of 77517.1 yuan. He later repaid tax, self-surrendered, prior conviction (some other crime) with probation period overlapping. The question: "请你模拟法官依据下面事实给出罪名。" So we need to output the crime(s). Based on Chinese criminal law, the crime is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (crime of falsifying special VAT invoices). Possibly also "骗取出口退税" but not here. It's just for tax deduction. So the charge: 虚开增值税专用发票. Also maybe "非法经营罪"? No. The facts: He obtained false invoices and used them to deduct tax, which is the crime of "虚开增值税专用发票罪". Also there is mention of prior conviction, but not a new crime. So single charge.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票<eoa>
